summary: Let Muse show pages and ask questions on your Kobo.
page_description: Turn your Kobo into a Muse gadget: Muse puts a status line, a page or a question on the e-ink panel, and your taps go back to it.
release_notes: First release. Pair with a computer running the Muse bridge, read pages Muse sends, and answer its questions with a tap.

steps.text: On a computer that is paired with Muse as a gadget, run the Muse bridge and note the address and pairing code it prints.
Install the certificate authority the bridge printed, so the panel can verify it.
